title: SFU Satellite Design Team
description: The SFU Satellite Design Team at Simon Fraser University designs and builds satellites, rovers and high altitude balloons. ALEASAT was tested at ESA's CubeSat Support Facility in 2026.

title: Projects
description: SFU Satellite Design Team projects: the ALEASAT CubeSat, the Polaris rover, high altitude balloons and Canadian Satellite Design Challenge entries.

title: ALEASAT
description: ALEASAT is a 1U CubeSat built by SFU Satellite Design Team and UBC Orbit, tested at ESA's CubeSat Support Facility in June 2026, with launch targeted for 2028.

title: Balloon 3
description: Balloon 3 launched from Carbon, Alberta in August 2021, reached 34 km and travelled 83.5 km before recovery.

title: Balloon 2
description: The SFU Satellite Design Team's second high altitude balloon mission.

title: Balloon 1
description: Latobius, the first high altitude balloon launched by the SFU Satellite Design Team.

title: CSDC5
description: The SFU Satellite Design Team's entry in the fifth Canadian Satellite Design Challenge.

title: CSDC4
description: The SFU Satellite Design Team's first entry in the Canadian Satellite Design Challenge.

title: CCP1
description: Canadian CubeSat Project 1, a 2U CubeSat built with two other universities and funded by the Canadian Space Agency.

title: Polaris Rover
description: Polaris is an autonomous rover being built for the Canadian International Rover Challenge in August 2027.

title: Rover Applications
description: Apply to join the SFU Satellite Design Team's rover subsystems: software, mechanical, communications, payload and electrical.
